scenario: [LUNI.8.8]: values of one dimension are valid, and the result has that dimension. `max(min(s.d, 10_meter), 1_meter) > 1_meter`, `(s.n ?? 0_meter) > 1_meter` and `s.d in (1_meter .. 5_meter)` all compile, and each result meets a `meter` on the other side. A check that refuses every dimensioned operand fails this. PATH PINNED: the non-refusing arms of `dsc.typecheck.luni_8_8_min_max_type`, `lnul_5_3_binary_type`'s `bo_coalesce`, `lint_2_2_interval` and `lint_3_1_3_in`.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    id: Int key
    d: meter mutable
    n: meter? mutable

rule a:
    R s where max(min(s.d, 10_meter), 1_meter) > 1_meter
->
    log info "a"

rule b:
    R s where (s.n ?? 0_meter) > 1_meter
->
    log info "b"

rule c:
    R s where s.d in (1_meter .. 5_meter)
->
    log info "c"
